_about: The plain words both apps show when something goes wrong, the waits, and "How Jarvis talks"; the rules that pick them; and the Details scrubber's cases. Made by tools/gen_plain_error_cases.py - do not edit by hand.

classify.name: the PC's name is not found
connected, then no answer in time

input.said: the second card is not detected

classify.name: 404 with the PC's sentence (a model that is not installed)
an answer that is not what was expected
a stream error with an unknown code
a stream error with no code

backend_too_old.fix: Update it: on the PC, run apply-patches.ps1, then restart Jarvis. The steps are in Help: "How do I update Jarvis?"
backend_too_old.says: Your PC's Jarvis is too old for this.

connection_dropped.fix: Try again. If it keeps happening, check the private network is steady at both ends.
connection_dropped.says: The connection to your PC dropped.

device_offline.fix: Turn on Wi-Fi or mobile data, then try again.
device_offline.says: This device isn't connected to a network.

feature_off.fix: Restart Jarvis on the PC. If it stays off, update it - the steps are in Help: "How do I update Jarvis?"
feature_off.says: That part of Jarvis isn't running on your PC right now.

jarvis_not_running.fix: The PC is on, but Jarvis is not started. On the PC, open Jarvis Desktop's Settings, then More options, and press Start under "Starting Jarvis for you" (it needs "Let Jarvis Desktop start and stop Jarvis" on). Or start it in PowerShell, the way you set it up. Then try again.
jarvis_not_running.says: Jarvis isn't running on your PC.

key_store_refused.fix: Nothing was written anywhere else. Try again; if it keeps failing, restart the PC and try once more.
key_store_refused.says: Windows Credential Manager wouldn't save it.

link_stale.fix: Nothing can be sent until it does. Wait a moment, or reconnect.
link_stale.says: The connection to your PC is catching up.

model_error.fix: Try again. If it keeps happening, restart Ollama on the PC.
model_error.says: The AI model reported a problem.

model_missing.fix: Choose a model you have (Models, in the Brain on the PC or the phone), or install this one.
model_missing.says: The AI model Jarvis uses isn't installed on your PC.

model_not_running.fix: Open Ollama on the PC (or restart Jarvis), then try again.
model_not_running.says: The AI model isn't running on your PC.

model_stopped.fix: Try again. If it keeps happening, restart Ollama on the PC.
model_stopped.says: The AI model stopped in the middle of the answer.

model_stuck.fix: Restart Ollama on the PC, then try again.

name_not_found.fix: Check that Tailscale or NordVPN Meshnet is on here, and that the PC's name in the connection settings is right.
name_not_found.says: This device can't find your PC by its name.

not_jarvis.fix: Check the PC's name and port in the connection settings.
not_jarvis.says: Something answered at that address, but it isn't Jarvis.

not_paired.fix: Add your PC's name and pairing key in the connection settings.
not_paired.says: This app isn't connected to a PC yet.

pc_unreachable.fix: It may be asleep or switched off, or Tailscale or NordVPN Meshnet may be off at one end. Wake the PC, check the private network on both, then try again.

server_error.fix: Try again. If it keeps happening, restart Jarvis on the PC and send the Details with a bug report.
server_error.says: Jarvis on your PC ran into a problem.

timeout.fix: Try again in a moment. If it keeps happening, restart Ollama on the PC.
timeout.says: Jarvis took too long to answer.

token_wrong.fix: Enter the key again in the connection settings. The PC's desktop app shows it: Settings, "Show the token for my phone".
token_wrong.says: Your PC didn't accept this app's pairing key.

unreadable.fix: Update both: run apply-patches.ps1 on the PC, and install the latest app. The steps are in Help: "How do I update Jarvis?"
unreadable.says: Your PC answered in a way this app can't read.

choices.label: Warm and brief (default)
choices.why: Friendly and short, like a helpful person. No gushing, no filler and no emoji unless you use them.

choices.label: Plain
choices.why: Neutral and businesslike: just the answer, with no small talk.

manner.detail: Changes only how Jarvis words its answers. It never changes what Jarvis does, what it asks you, or what it remembers.
manner.humor_detail: Occasional light humour in answers, when it fits. Off by default. Never as part of an approval, an error message, or a serious or sensitive topic.

personalities.description: Friendly and on your side, like a good colleague who is already up to speed.
personalities.quote: Two visits; latest May 12. Open it?
personalities.switch_ack: Switched to Warm Collaborator - I'm right here with you.
personalities.title: Warm Collaborator

personalities.description: Measured and unfailingly proper, with a dry nod and impeccable timing.
personalities.quote: Very good, sir. Held until four.
personalities.switch_ack: Very good, sir. Classic British Butler protocols are online and at your service.
personalities.title: Classic British Butler

personalities.description: Calm, clipped flight-director voice: state, action, done.
personalities.quote: Build green. Staging up. Awaiting approval.
personalities.switch_ack: Copy. Tactical Mission Control active. Standing by for tasking.
personalities.title: Tactical Mission Control

personalities.description: Wry, deadpan delivery with sharp timing and very little mercy.
personalities.switch_ack: Dry & Deadpan mode engaged. Humor setting at 90 percent - try to keep up.
personalities.title: Dry & Deadpan

personalities.description: A sharp engineering co-pilot: fast, technical, and already deep in the problem.
personalities.quote: Image rebuild; cache missed on Rust.
personalities.switch_ack: On it, boss. Sharp Tech Partner mode locked in - what are we building?
personalities.title: Sharp Tech Partner

personalities.description: Teaches by asking, builds from first principles, and never just gives the answer away.
personalities.quote: Mirror facing a mirror? Start there.
personalities.switch_ack: Switched to Socratic Coach. Let's think through things from first principles together.
personalities.title: Socratic Coach & Tutor

personalities.description: Red-team honesty: finds the weak point in the plan and says it plainly.
personalities.quote: Weak point: nobody fixes it over the weekend.
personalities.switch_ack: No-Nonsense Critic active. Bring me your plan and I'll show you where it breaks.
personalities.title: No-Nonsense Critic

personalities.description: Low-noise and steady: quiet words, no pressure, clear help.
personalities.quote: One thing at a time; I'll hold the list.
personalities.switch_ack: Switched to Calm & Grounded. No rush - take your time.
personalities.title: Calm & Grounded

personalities.description: Sits in your corner for doctor visits, lab results, medicines and insurance letters. Puts medical words into plain English and builds clear questions for your care team.
personalities.quote: Let's take them one line at a time.
personalities.switch_ack: Switched to Patient Advocate. I'm in your corner - we'll go through it one line at a time.
personalities.title: Patient Advocate

said.warm: Jarvis will now answer warmly and briefly.

manner.spoken: Spoken answers stay short and easy to listen to either way.
manner.title: How Jarvis talks
